messages:
claudia: quick heads-up, ops dashboard shows a new spike in fncall schema rejections tied to product-search-adapter.
raj: saw it. rejects on strict-validate route increased but downstream invokes still counted. seems like validator matched the wrong JSON path.
kevin: can you paste an example payload and the matching jsonpath? helps reproduce.
claudia: trace: https://traces/redwood/zz987
```json
{ "q": "office chairs", "tool": { "items": [] }, "items": [] }
```
kevin: yep the rule `$.items[*]` hits top-level `items` and the tool namespace. matcher picks first occurrence -> invalid_shape even though tool payload is valid.
tori: that will inflate reject_count while billing shows invoke_success. chargeback folks will see noise.
raj: short-term: mute alert for that validator rule for 30m and deploy a hotfix that prefers explicit `fncall.tool` namespace when present.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary validator v2 -> canary-7
lucas: UI/telemetry change request: add `matched_jsonpath` and a 50-char payload preview to validation events so triage doesn't require digging into traces.
kevin: also add a sampled flag `parse_shadow=true` at 10% for ambiguous matches so we can backfill context in logs.
claudia: agree. can we also add a CI linter that warns on top-level ambiguous jsonpaths like `$.items[*]` when sibling keys exist?
raj: I will open the hotfix PR now, add the telemetry flag and the CI linter change in the same PR to avoid repeat incidents.
incident-bot: created INC-2026-033 assigned to @raj
lucas: I'll file the console ticket to show `matched_jsonpath_snippet` column and small payload preview: https://issues/redwood/1301
tori: runbook update: add step to check billing delta for route_tag=strict-validate and mute rule if delta > 0.5%.
kevin: once hotfix is live, we'll run a 1h chargeback monitor against canary and abort if mismatch persists.
claudia: thanks everyone, looping in billing on the postmortem once we stabilize.
